description: Analogue-modelled low-pass filter with two-pole and four-pole outputs, a band-pass output, and a VCA on the four-pole output

params.text: Sets the resonance, which begins to self-oscillate at about three quarters of the way up
Attenuverts the FM input, which shifts the cutoff

inputs.text: Shifts the cutoff, one volt per octave
Shifts the cutoff through the FM attenuverter, one volt per octave at full clockwise
The audio to be filtered; the number of channels on this cable sets how many voices the module runs, up to sixteen
Sets the gain of the VCA output, 0V silencing it and 5V giving unity, with higher voltages progressively compressed; with nothing patched it reads 12V rather than the 7V of the manual

outputs.text: The two-pole band-pass tap, falling away at 12dB per octave on both sides
The two-pole low-pass tap, 12dB per octave
The four-pole low-pass output, 24dB per octave
The four-pole low-pass output through the VCA, whose gain the GAIN input sets

notes: this module has no right-click menu of its own.
